subject: Request: product walkthrough — CandleShop trial
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@candleshop.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: product walkthrough — CandleShop trial

Hi Ben,

I just signed up for the self-serve trial (CandleShop account) and would love a short product walkthrough so our team can evaluate Redwood for two immediate use cases:

- Auto-generated product descriptions for long-tail SKUs
- Improving search relevance / query rewriting on our storefront

Quick context on volume & timeline: we currently do ~500k monthly sessions, expect the feature to be used on ~5% of pageviews initially (so rough traffic profile of 20–30k calls/month), with a pilot target in October and production in early Q1 2028.

Are you able to do a 20–30 minute walkthrough this week? Happy to share any usage numbers or a sandbox account beforehand.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Product
CandleShop

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@candleshop.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: product walkthrough — CandleShop trial

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. I can take you through the platform and focus the demo on product description generation + search relevance. A couple quick questions so I tailor the walkthrough and can give some realistic perf/cost estimates: 

1) Typical request shape: average prompt + expected response length (estimated tokens per call)?
2) Concurrency / peak requests per minute you expect during launches or promotions?
3) Data sensitivity: will calls include PII or customer emails? Any regulatory constraints?
4) Do you need EU data residency / on-prem/VPC options or is hosted fine for evaluation?
5) Success criteria for the pilot (latency, quality metrics, cost targets)?

If that works, I can send a 25-minute invite. I have the following windows available (PT):
- Thu 9/16 10:00–10:30
- Thu 9/16 14:00–14:30
- Fri 9/17 09:00–09:30

I'll attach a one-pager with typical throughput profiles so you have something to share internally. If you prefer, Monica (our Solutions Engineer, cc'd) can join to talk integration details and sandbox access.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (product + perf summary)

On Wed, Sep 15, 2027 at 12:41 PM Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> From: Alex Rivera <alex@candleshop.co>
> To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
> Date: 2027-09-15T11:33:00-07:00

Hi Ben / Monica — thanks for the quick reply and the one-pager. Answers below: 

> 1) Typical request shape: average prompt + expected response length (estimated tokens per call)?
Our prompts are usually short (product title + 2–3 attributes), responses average ~120 tokens.

> 2) Concurrency / peak requests per minute you expect during launches or promotions?
Baseline will be low (single-digit concurrent requests), but during big marketing pushes we could spike to ~150–200 concurrent small requests for a few minutes.

> 3) Data sensitivity: will calls include PII or customer emails? Any regulatory constraints?
We avoid including full PII in prompts, but we will pass partial customer attributes (city/zip) for personalization. No EU residency requirement for the pilot — US hosted is fine.

> 4) Do you need EU data residency / on-prem/VPC options or is hosted fine for evaluation?
Hosted evaluation is fine.

> 5) Success criteria for the pilot (latency, quality metrics, cost targets)?
We want sub-250ms median token latency for short responses, a measurable uplift in click-through for rewritten descriptions (+5–7%), and a pilot cap of ~$3k–5k TCO for initial evaluation.

All three times you suggested work for us, preference: Thu 9/16 14:00–14:30 PT. Please send the invite and any sandbox steps we should run before the call.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Product | CandleShop
alex@candleshop.co
